summary: The repair bounds exported Go callbacks at eight and closes same-root reentry during init and explicit unmount, with correct hidden safe IDs, exact arity checks, stale-handle fencing, and instance-map cleanup by inspection. One mount panic-cleanup gap remains: LIFO defers release the root reservation before the recovery handler unmounts a renderer if rendererAPI construction panics, allowing reentrant mount during cleanup. Adapter tests and smoke syntax checks passed; Go/WASM and Chromium execution were unavailable.
